_comment: AI drivers (card 05). cornerMargin = fraction of the computed safe corner speed it uses; brakeMargin = fraction of its estimated max braking it plans with (lower = brakes earlier); lookahead = baseM + perMps x speed; steerKp = gain on the pure-pursuit wheel angle (1 = geometric), steerKd = damping on heading-error change; noise = random steer jitter; mistakesPerMin = chance of a late brake or a wide line; traffic = forward cone and overtaking offset. pits: stop when fuel < fuelLaps laps or any tyre < minWear; drive the pit lane pitSpeedMarginKph under the limit; with Realistic damage, pit for repair once any zone is past repairDamage. recovery.resetAfterSec: still crawling or stuck this long (reverse-outs not getting it going) -> reset to track like a player, same penalty. start: reaction to lights out, random in min..max per driver. aids: traction control on the rears' slip, as a fraction of peak (03b); trail*: steering more than trailSteer and over its target speed, the AI brakes in proportion to the overspeed (full trailMaxPedal at trailOverspeedMps) instead of a firm 30%+, so the unloaded inside front doesn't lock. traffic.sideGapM: lateral gap kept to a car alongside beyond the cars' width (3-wide is fine if it fits). pitLane: through the lane it keeps fastLaneM off the pit path away from the boxes (single file, no passing; it follows only a car in its lane, within its width + laneGapM, and ignores cars parked in boxes), moves across into its own box boxApproachM before it at latRateMps, and waits in the box until the lane is clear releaseGapM back (contact.json pitLaneGhosting lets pit-lane cars pass through each other). skill.spread: how far a roster driver's PACE stat (config/drivers.json) moves its corner and braking margins (+-spread at pace 0 / 100); the roster's other stats set mistakes, noise, tyre care, aggression and racecraft. racecraft (AI racecraft card): three lines, NEUTRAL (the racing line), EXIT (through a corner before at least exitStraightM of straight, the line re-optimised through it and exitShiftM past it with the exit's curvature weighted exitWeight x the entry's: a later apex) and INSIDE (insideM toward the inside from insideLeadM before a corner to its apex, edgeM from the edge), picked by a mode re-evaluated every evalSec and held at least holdSec: ATTACK (car ahead within attackGapSec and closing, or in its tow: EXIT before a straight, else INSIDE), DEFEND (car behind within defendGapSec closing: INSIDE), NURSE (average tyre below nurseWear or damage past nurseDamage), MANAGE (else: NEUTRAL). Lines blend at blendPerM of a full change per metre; during a blend the slower line's speed counts. coast: lift and coast for small speed drops (<= coastMaxDropMps, above coastMinKph, within 1.5 s) instead of braking, and lift liftBeforeBrakeSec before a braking zone. Tune by racing them (panel: T).
